Collections -  

1. cancers 
1. genes 
1. drugs 
1. drugs india 

\### Collection: \*\*cancers\*\* 

\*\*Purpose\*\*: Stores structured data around cancer, its subtypes, associated biomarkers, incidence and prevalence information, links to major clinical guidelines and clinical calculators. 

\*\*Fields\*\*: 

* `\_id` (ObjectId): unique cancer document ID (auto-generated by MongoDB) 
* `cancer\_name` (String, unique): e.g., "Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer" 
* `cancer\_organ\_category` (String): e.g., "Lung", "Breast", "Prostate" 
* `cancer\_incidence\_prevalance` (String): epidemiological data as a string 
* `cancer\_survival\_rates` (String): survival statistics, formatted as a string 
* `cancer\_biomarkers` (String): description or listing of biomarkers 
* `cancer\_biomarkers\_tags` (Array<String>): individual biomarker tags (e.g., \["EGFR", "ALK"]) 
* `cancer\_types` (String): broad cancer classification (e.g., "Adenocarcinoma") 
* `subtypes` (String): descriptive string of subtype(s) 
* `subtypes\_tags` (Array<String>): structured tags for subtypes 
* `related\_cancers\_tags` (Array<String>): tags linking related cancer types 
* `md\_anderson\_guidelines` (Array<String>): references to internal guidelines 
* `esmo\_guidelines` (Array<String>): titles or links to ESMO guideline documents 
* `nccn\_guidelines\_titles` (Array<String>): guideline titles from NCCN 
* `nccn\_guidelines\_links` (Array<String>): corresponding NCCN URLs 
* `asco\_guidelines\_titles` (Array<String>): ASCO guideline titles 
* `asco\_guidelines\_links` (Array<String>): ASCO URLs 
* `md\_anderson\_calulator\_titles` (Array<String>): names of calculators/tools 
* `md\_anderson\_calulator\_links` (Array<String>): links to calculators/tools 
* `source\_titles` (Array<String>): source reference titles (e.g., publication names) 
* `source\_links` (Array<String>): links to source documents or websites 

\### Collection: \*\*genes\*\* 

\*\*Purpose\*\*: Stores gene-centric clinical and scientific metadata relevant to cancer types, drug associations, clinical trials, and evidence sources, with deep contextual references to prognosis, co-mutations, drug efficacy, and regulatory information. 

\*\*Fields\*\*: 

* `\_id` (ObjectId): unique document ID 
* `gene\_name` (String): gene symbol (e.g., "TP53") 
* `ncbi\_gene\_code\_for\_gene` (String): official NCBI gene code 
* `cancer\_types` (Array<String>): associated cancer types (e.g., "Lung Cancer") 
* `cancer\_types\_tags` (Array<String>): tagified version of `cancer\_types` 
* `ncit\_code\_for\_cancer\_types` (Array<String>): NCIt codes for each cancer 
* `gene\_cancer\_type\_source\_apas` (Array<String>): APA-style citations 
* `gene\_cancer\_type\_source\_links` (Array<String>): URLs to supporting sources 
* `overview` (String): textual summary of gene functions and relevance 
* `gene\_overview\_sources` (Array<String>): supporting source citations 
* `subtypes` (String): gene-associated cancer subtypes 
* `gene\_subtypes\_source\_apas` (Array<String>): APA citations 
* `gene\_subtypes\_source\_links` (Array<String>): source URLs 
* `incidence` (String): context-specific incidence information 
* `gene\_cancer\_incidence\_source\_apas` (Array<String>): APA citations 
* `gene\_cancer\_incidence\_source\_links` (Array<String>): source URLs 
* `prognosis` (String): gene impact on cancer prognosis 
* `gene\_cancer\_prognosis\_source\_apas` (Array<String>): APA-style citations 
* `gene\_cancer\_prognosis\_source\_links` (Array<String>): URLs to supporting sources 
* `gene\_cancer\_cooccurring\_mutations` (Array<String>): URLs to supporting sources 
* `gene\_cancer\_coocurring\_mutations\_source\_apas` (Array<String>): APA-style citations 
* `gene\_cancer\_coocurring\_mutations\_source\_links` (Array<String>): URLs to supporting sources 
* `is\_drug\_approved` (String): Whether the drug is approved in US 
* `product\_status` (String): e.g., "Approved", "Investigational", "In trial" 
* `drug\_name` (String): matched drug name 
* `constituent\_drugs` (Array<String>): split version of combination therapies 
* `gene\_drug\_source\_titles` (Array<String>): publication/report titles 
* `gene\_drug\_source\_links` (Array<String>): URLs to supporting sources 
* `efficacy` (String): summary of clinical performance 
* `efficacy\_source\_titles` (Array<String>): Supporting sources 
* `efficacy\_source\_links` (Array<String>): URLs to supporting sources 
* `brand\_name` (Array<String>): drug brands 
* `company\_name` (Array<String>): manufacturing companies 
* `drug\_fda\_filename` (Array<String>): FDA document names 
* `drug\_fda\_link` (Array<String>): links to FDA records 
* `is\_combination` (String): If it is a combination drug or not 
* `drug\_overview` (String): overview of a drug 
* `gene\_drug\_overview\_sources` (Array<String>): URLs to supporting sources 
* `drug\_target` (Array<String>): affected pathways/proteins 
* `gene\_drug\_target\_sources` (Array<String>): URLs to supporting sources 
* `landmark\_clinical\_trial\_id` (Array<String>): e.g., \["NCT01234567"] 
* `gene\_drug\_landmark\_sources` (Array<String>): URLs to supporting sources 
* `ct\_phase` (Array<String>): clinical trial phase 
* `ct\_title` (Array<String>): clinical trial title 
* `ct\_location` (Array<String>): clinical trial location 
* `ct\_publication\_titles` (Array<String>): clinical trial publication title 
* `ct\_publication\_apas` (Array<String>): clinical trial publication title in APA format 
* `ct\_publication\_links` (Array<String>): clinical trial publication link 
* `intrial\_drug\_nct` (String): current trial NCT ID 

\### Collection: \*\*drugs\*\* 

\*\*Purpose\*\*: Stores comprehensive information on cancer drugs, including their classification, biomarker relevance, approvals, efficacy, trial data, and links to regulatory and clinical sources across geographies. 

\*\*Fields\*\*: 

* `\_id` (ObjectId): Unique document ID 
* `drug\_name` (String): Canonical or generic name of the drug 
* `constituent\_drugs` (Array<String>): List of component drugs (for combinations) 
* `constituent\_drugs\_db` (Array<Object>): List of component drugs (for combinations) with details such as name of the drug, if it approved as monotherapy and type of therapy and platform, along with object id to india brands. 
  * `drug\_name` (String): constituent drug name 
  * `present\_in\_db` (Boolean): is the drug present in the database 
  * `approved\_as\_monotherapy` (String): Yes/No 
  * `india\_product\_brand` (ObjectId): reference to `drugs\_india` 
* `is\_combination` (Boolean): Indicates if the drug is a combination therapy 
* `code\_for\_drug` (String): Internal/standardized drug code 
* `target` (Array<String>): primary targets (e.g., EGFR, HER2) 
* `target\_tags` (Array<String>): standardized tags 
* `target\_action` (Array<String>): action on targets (e.g., inhibitor) 
* `ncbi\_gene\_code\_for\_target` (Array<String>): related gene codes 
* `gene\_mutations` (Array<String>): associated mutations (e.g., BRAF V600E) 
* `cancer\_types` (Array<String>) 
* `cancer\_types\_tags` (Array<String>) 
* `cancer\_subtypes\_tags` (Array<String>) 
* `ncit\_code\_for\_cancer\_types` (Array<String>) 
* `biomarkers` (Array<String>) 
* `biomarkers\_tags` (Array<String>) 
* `cancer\_biomarkers\_tags` (Array<String>) 
* `code\_for\_biomarkers` (Array<String>) 
* `biomarker\_description` (String) 
* `biomarker\_test\_score` (String) 
* `biomarker\_interpretation` (String) 
* `prognosis` (String): impact on cancer prognosis 
* `is\_drug\_approved` (String): "Yes" or "No" 
* `product\_status` (String): e.g., "Approved", "Investigational" 
* `product\_status\_overall` (String): high-level status across cancers 
* `drug\_source\_titles` (Array<String>): names of publications or databases 
* `drug\_source\_links` (Array<String>) 
* `drug\_fda\_filename` (Array<String>) 
* `drug\_fda\_link` (Array<String>) 
* `brand\_name` (Array<String>) 
* `brand\_website\_links` (Array<String>) 
* `company\_name` (Array<String>) 
* `type\_of\_therapy` (Array<String>): e.g., "Targeted Therapy", "Immunotherapy" 
* `drug\_class` (Array<String>) 
* `mechanism\_of\_action` (String) 
* `efficacy` (String): brief overview of efficacy data 
* `efficacy\_source\_titles` (Array<String>) 
* `efficacy\_source\_links` (Array<String>) 
* `indications` (String) 
* `limitations\_of\_use` (String) 
* `drug\_interactions` (String) 
* `side\_effects` (String) 
* `warnings\_and\_precautions` (String) 
* `contraindications` (String) 
* `dosage\_and\_administration` (String) 
* `dose\_adjustments` (String) 
* `landmark\_clinical\_trial\_id` (Array<String>) 
* `ct\_phase` (Array<String>) 
* `ct\_title` (Array<String>) 
* `ct\_publication\_titles` (Array<String>) 
* `ct\_publication\_apas` (Array<String>) 
* `ct\_publication\_links` (Array<String>) 
* `intrial\_drug\_nct` (String): trial in which this drug is currently being tested 
* `investigational\_trial\_nct\_ids` (Array<String>) 
* `investigational\_trial\_partners` (Array<String>) 
* `ongoing\_clinical\_trials\_master\_link` (Array<String>) 
* `ongoing\_clinical\_trials\_nct` (Array<ObjectId>): references `clinical\_trial` 
* `ongoing\_clinical\_trials\_ctri` (Array<ObjectId>): references `india\_clinical\_trial` 
* `ncit\_ids` (Array<String>) 
* `ndcs` (Array<String>) 
* `india\_product` (ObjectId): reference to `drugs\_india` 
* `india\_product\_brands` (Array<ObjectId>): references to `drugs\_india` 

\### Collection: \*\*drugs\\_india\*\* 

\*\*Purpose\*\*: Stores detailed information on cancer drugs available in India, including approval status (e.g., CDSCO), biomarkers, cancer types, clinical trials, and supporting evidence from both Indian and global sources. 

--- \*\*Fields\*\*: 

* `\_id` (ObjectId): unique document ID 
* `drug\_name` (String): name of the drug (generic or combination) 
* `is\_chemotherapy\_drug` (Boolean): true if classified as chemotherapy 
* `constituent\_drugs` (Array<String>): components of combination drugs 
* `abbreviations` (Array<String>): acronyms or short forms (e.g., FOLFOX) 
* `code\_for\_drug` (String): internal or standardized drug code 
* `target` (Array<String>): drug targets (e.g., EGFR, HER2) 
* `target\_tags` (Array<String>): structured tags for targets 
* `ncbi\_gene\_code\_for\_target` (Array<String>): corresponding gene codes 
* `gene\_mutations` (Array<String>): e.g., BRAF V600E, KRAS G12C 
* `cancer\_types` (Array<String>) 
* `cancer\_types\_tags` (Array<String>) 
* `ncit\_code\_for\_cancer\_types` (Array<String>) 
* `biomarkers` (Array<String>) 
* `biomarkers\_tags` (Array<String>) 
* `code\_for\_biomarkers` (Array<String>) 
* `biomarker\_description` (String) 
* `biomarker\_test\_score` (String) 
* `biomarker\_interpretation` (String) 
* `prognosis` (String): drug's impact on prognosis 
* `is\_drug\_approved` (String): Yes / No 
* `is\_drug\_approved\_by\_cdsco` (String): CDSCO-specific approval status 
* `product\_status` (String): e.g., Approved, In trial 
* `drug\_source\_titles` (Array<String>) 
* `drug\_source\_links` (Array<String>) 
* `drug\_fda\_filename` (Array<String>) 
* `drug\_fda\_link` (Array<String>) 
* `brand\_name` (Array<String>) 
* `brand\_website\_links` (Array<String>) 
* `company\_name` (Array<String>) 
* `type\_of\_therapy` (String): e.g., Targeted Therapy 
* `drug\_class` (String): e.g., TKI 
* `mechanism\_of\_action` (String): short description of drug action 
* `efficacy` (String): summary 
* `efficacy\_source\_titles` (Array<String>) 
* `efficacy\_source\_links` (Array<String>) 
* `indications` (String) 
* `limitations\_of\_use` (String) 
* `drug\_interactions` (String) 
* `side\_effects` (String) 
* `warnings\_and\_precautions` (String) 
* `contraindications` (String) 
* `dosage\_and\_administration` (String) 
* `dose\_adjustments` (String) 
* `landmark\_clinical\_trial\_id` (Array<String>) 
* `ct\_phase` (Array<String>) 
* `ct\_title` (Array<String>) 
* `ct\_publication\_titles` (Array<String>) 
* `ct\_publication\_apas` (Array<String>) 
* `ct\_publication\_links` (Array<String>) 
* `intrial\_drug\_nct` (String): ongoing NCT for this drug 
* `ongoing\_clinical\_trials\_master\_link` (Array<String>): URLs 
* `contact\_information` (Array<String>) 
* `ncit\_ids` (Array<String>) 
* `ndcs` (Array<String>) 
* `drugs.constituent\_drugs\_db.india\_product\_brand` 
* `drugs.india\_product` 
* `drugs.india\_product\_brands` 
* Trial data (NCT, CT info) aligns with the \*\*`clinical\_trial`\*\* or \*\*`india\_clinical\_trial`\*\* collections 
* Biomarkers, gene mutations, and targets align with data in \*\*`genes`\*\* 
* Cancer types map to entries in the \*\*`cancers`\*\* collection 
* Drug name may be referenced across multiple datasets for harmonization
